subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], Thank you for booking your upcoming flight with us. We are pleased to confirm that your reservation for Flight ABC123 from City X to City Y on Date, departing at Time, has been successfully processed. Please remember to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure for check-in. We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to serving you on board. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. Safe travels! Best regards, Airline XYZ
